Lofoten Krigsminnemuseum

LocationFiskergata 3, 8300 Svolvær, Norway
Visited25 August 2025
WebsiteLofoten War Memorial Museum

Museum Report

We had a brief stop in Svolvær during my Hurtigruten cruise, and during my walk ashore I stumbled across the Lofoten War Memorial Museum. They are a fairly small local museum, and advertise themselves as having Norway’s largest exhibition of uniforms and smaller objects from World War II.

From a naval perspective, they did have a number of paintings, photographs, models and information boards covering topics such as the Lofoten raid, and the sinkings of Blucher and Glorious, while they had a fairly wide variety of smaller artefacts from the WW2 era.

Signage was largely bilingual. This is a good little museum which is worth dropping into if you ever happen to be in Svolvær.
